column1: # Every place this port copies or reimplements upstream logic, with the hash of the upstream
# file as it stood when we last checked it. `scripts/check-upstream.sh` recomputes those
# hashes and reports what has changed.
# The point is not to automate re-porting -- that will always need judgement -- it is to
# remove the need to *notice*. Silent divergence from upstream is the real risk: a change to
# the loot CSV format or an item-record field would otherwise surface as corrupted data
# Columns: upstream-path <TAB> our-path <TAB> what we take from it
# Re-record hashes after reviewing a change with:  scripts/check-upstream.sh --accept
